prompt: As of August 3rd 2024, which movie using the Technicolor dye-transfer process was the last to win the Academy Award for Best Picture?
answer: **_The Godfather Part II_ (1974)** was the last film using Technicolor’s dye-transfer (IB) printing process to win the Academy Award for Best Picture. It won at the **47th Academy Awards in 1975**. The AFI notes that it was also the last American film released on Technicolor dye-transfer prints.
